web_events.answer: This week's US economic data release includes the Consumer Price Index (CPI) and core CPI on Friday, September 11, with inflation tracking at 3.38% year over year and 0.20% sequentially for core CPI. The August jobs report, released earlier, showed 162,000 new jobs created, the highest since March, with significant growth in healthcare and social assistance, accommodation and food service, and local government. The unemployment rate remains low, and the U-6 measure fell to a 14-month low of 7.7%

web_events.query: China PMI economic data this week
web_events.answer: China's official National Bureau of Statistics (NBS) manufacturing PMI edged up to 49.8 in August from 49.2, slightly beating consensus forecasts of 49.7. The private RatingDog manufacturing PMI expanded to 51.5 versus 51.0 expected. China's RatingDog services PMI accelerated to 51.4 in August from 50.4 in July, outperforming consensus estimates of 50.6.
